title: Otori Emu — Smiling Fairy〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Thank you very much!
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew... Thank goodness I was able to get my hands on it. Thanks for coming with me, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, so, that's a book by someone from ArcLand, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. It's by a director famous for princess characters.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's full of tips and pointers for being more princessly, so I thought it might come in handy for my role for the contest.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're putting so much effort into this princess role, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't wait to see you after you level up all with that book, like b-baaam!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really don't think it's going to be quite that sudden...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'll do what I can before the day of the contest. Including in practice tonight.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... That's all I wanted to buy, but is there anything you want, Emu? I'd be happy to go with you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm, anything I wanna buy... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, hey, Nene! Are you hungry?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? A little, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Great! Then there's a place I wanna go!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I didn't expect you to want to go to your usual taiyaki place.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! They're starting a special seasonal menu today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: See, look! Rainbow taiyaki!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wow... Pink, blue, green...
They've got all sorts of colors.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Isn't it so exciting just looking at them? And apparently each color is a different flavor!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, it says the yellow one is grapefruit bean paste!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh, grapefruit bean paste?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm having trouble imagining what that would be like... But I guess it sounds good?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh, the blue kind has soda candy flavor paste! I bet that would make Rui super smiley!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which one do you think Tsukasa would like the most?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe this banana one? He really liked that chocolate banana parfait he got at the diner the other day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh, that's gotta be it! He was all, “Yes, this is delicious!” at the top of his voice!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... And then everyone turned to stare at us...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I bet KAITO would like the melon flavor.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I brought some melon-flavored candy to SEKAI a while back, and KAITO said it was really tasty!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How about everyone else? I bet Miku would like the muscat flavor. And the apple one too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad you're thinking of everyone, but why not choose one for yourself first?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Hmm, maybe the pink strawberry one for me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's hard to choose from this many flavors. I'd like to try a lot of them, but it's only for a limited time...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! I know!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, I just had a great idea!
bgm_area00004
That night
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great. Let's take a break here.

rows.Speaker: Emu & Miku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you as always for spending so long helping with our practices.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No need for thanks! We're all excited to see a new show getting off the ground!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You've all been improving steadily. I can't wait to see the finished thing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right. Emu was especially dynamic as the fairy today... Hm?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Speaking of, where is Emu?
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone! Your attention, please!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Behold! I have special snacks for everyone today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ooh, snacks?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-daa! We bought a whole bunch of rainbow taiyaki!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow, look at that! So many different colors!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Aren't they just so cute?☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But so many... What's the occasion?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me and Nene visited the taiyaki place today, and it felt like a waste to only get some for the two of us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And when we saw these special limited-time flavors, we wanted to let everyone try them together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. How truly considerate of you! I was just thinking I could use a little something.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We really appreciate the thought, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No problem! Go ahead and pick whichever ones you like!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's see... I'll take this soda candy taiyaki, then.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I choose this banana one! I've been on a banana kick lately!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's see... I think I'll have this melon one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want the muscat! Oh, but the apple one looks good too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You hit the bullseye with everyone, huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, I did!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's all have lots of tasty taiyaki, and then work hard for the rest of practice!
